repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computed the difference as v2 - v1 (current minus initial), but the IR specifies ($v1 - $v2) (initial minus current). Since the input volume rose from 0 to 20, v1 - v2 is -20, which is not >= 20, so the IR takes the else branch (no action). The candidate's reversed subtraction yielded 20, triggering a false positive action at the mismatch instant.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the conditional from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's logic of detecting a volume drop.
